correctness.rationale: The row-normalized scalar projection is exactly the selected right-hand side. Conditioning on an integer hypergeometric corruption count gives both Markov transitions, eigenvalue and covariance identity; exact partition/overlap of tail events proves sign changes. At median, the majority label is sample-only, hence independent outputs, geometric hitting law, sharp finite sample cutoff and a.s. recurrence by iid Borel–Cantelli. Falling-factorial uniform approximation, Stirling and dominated geometric tail summation independently reconstruct the sharp prefactor and horizon. An exhaustive finite-size standard-library verifier checks 431,104 exact-combinatorial and numerical assertions, without substituting experiments for proof.

The checked full text does not give the exact two-state transition matrix, odd-rank serial-correlation sign reversal, independent median output process with finite-population one-step cutoff, and sharp constant-level binomial/hypergeometric horizon for this same sampled-row equality update. Related later sources use different update-selection mechanisms or general expected-error bounds. Search limitations and remaining priority risk are explicit; this is only a model-specific novelty assessment.
residual_risks: A separate specialist paper may have derived the same binary-row hypergeometric chain or majority-vote limit under alternative terminology.
Finite text search and ranked record retrieval cannot prove global novelty.
Original source uses a slightly ambiguous tie selection notation, but both measurement values give unique updated scalar states within each quantile-tied class.
The original 2023 paper already anticipates rare corruption spikes and quantile/sample-size importance; those qualitative observations alone are not claimed as new.

The 2023 Swartworth dissertation on QuantileRK has potentially relevant sample-size and quantile-selection sections; only an indexed table of contents was accessible due to repository browser gating. Exact priority comparison remains uncompleted.

value.rationale: The motivating 2023 source explicitly leaves theoretical analysis of very small samples and choice of quantile / size for future work. This theorem supplies a nontrivial structural benchmark rather than simply recomputing a table: exact Markov dynamics, unique decorrelation rank, reversal to negative correlations at high ranks, a finite-population absolute safe cutoff, and a sharp tail prefactor identifying when successful short runs are misleading. Its precise limitations to a scalar repeated-row toy example are essential and stated; generic convergence for real matrices is not asserted.
